description: This file defines interfaces and classes for WebSocket stream handling, including connection management, handshake processing, frame reading/writing, and error handling within the Chromium networking code.

classes.name: WebSocketStreamRequest
classes.description: Interface for handling WebSocket stream creation requests, with virtual destructor.

classes.name: WebSocketStreamRequestAPI
classes.description: Extends WebSocketStreamRequest to expose methods used during handshake, such as stream creation callbacks and failure handling.

classes.name: WebSocketStream
classes.description: Abstract interface for WebSocket stream operations including reading, writing, closing, and retrieving negotiated protocols and extensions.

classes.name: WebSocketStream::ConnectDelegate
classes.description: Interface for receiving connection results, including success, failure, request creation, SSL errors, and authentication events.

methods.name: WebSocketStreamRequestAPI::OnBasicHandshakeStreamCreated
methods.description: Callback when a basic handshake stream is created.

methods.name: WebSocketStreamRequestAPI::OnHttp2HandshakeStreamCreated
methods.description: Callback when an HTTP/2 handshake stream is created.

methods.name: WebSocketStreamRequestAPI::OnHttp3HandshakeStreamCreated
methods.description: Callback when an HTTP/3 handshake stream is created.

methods.name: WebSocketStreamRequestAPI::OnFailure
methods.description: Callback for connection failure with error message and code.

methods.name: WebSocketStream::CreateAndConnectStream
methods.description: Static method to initiate creation and connection of a WebSocket stream.

methods.name: WebSocketStream::CreateAndConnectStreamForTesting
methods.description: Testing variant of stream creation with additional parameters.
